response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS o FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_h FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_h > o.o), keptmean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS km FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_h AS avg_humidity, k.avg_h - o.o AS excess_over_overall, k.avg_h - km.km AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN keptmean km WHERE o.o IS NOT NULL AND km.km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
